scope: Strengthen AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE ASCII/Binary allocation rollback and retry assertions for the full initialized public style profile.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored in-memory DRW_MLeaderStyle generated during each test run
source.profile: One AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE with version 2, description, default text, text height, and two EED entries with distinct application and record group codes.

implementation.method: Compare type, handle, parent, styleVersion, description, textDefault, textHeight, and both EED codes and values after clean calibration, every injected allocation failure, and retry. Retain destination-sentinel rollback, same-codec exact-byte retry, and fresh typed readback.

limitations: Generated object transport and transaction evidence only; producer interoperability and native MLEADERSTYLE rendering are not qualified.
Only the initialized fields of one AC1027 style profile are compared; other style values and dependency graphs remain open.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: The initialized MLEADERSTYLE caller profile remains unchanged on clean write, every injected failure, and same-codec retry, with byte-identical output and typed readback.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue the exact public-writer inventory and caller-state audit; retain producer, dependency, and native semantic gates.
